metadata.datasource: Read off the vector charts of HARMAN technology, MULTIGRADE FB CLASSIC technical information (Oct 2013): MULTIGRADE FB CLASSIC glossy through filter grade 1 (ISO R110 on Ilford's table, as on RC Deluxe's), MULTIGRADE developer 1+9, 2 min at 20 C; the sheet plots density over the paper base (its curves start at 0.00), and gives the base no figure, so it is Multigrade RC Deluxe's, whose sheet plots gross density, an estimate; spectral sensitivity read as relative log sensitivity, peak 1.0, level set so the paper sees as much of the enlarger lamp as Kodak Portra Endura does through its neutral filtration. Base 0.056; mid-grey (18% reflectance) at log E 0. One silver layer, carried as three identical channels.
